CoreModels.description: Immutable records, value objects, and domain enums. Terminal leaf nodes with zero UI or external I/O dependencies.

CoreContracts.description: Strict C# interface contracts defining service boundaries, async signatures with CancellationToken, and decoupling ViewModels from concrete implementations.
invariants: Zero UI types in contract parameters or return values
100% XML doc comments in American English

StorageServices.description: SQLite DAL 4.0 persistence engine in WAL journal mode with connection pooling, SemaphoreSlim serialized writes, schema migrator (v400), and DPAPI credential protection.

CryptoServices.description: AES-256-CBC zcid hex encryption, Base64 parameter encryption, trusted-device keychain envelopes with HKDF-SHA256, XOR 147 media de-noising, and Signal Protocol Double Ratchet E2EE with 60-digit Safety Numbers.
invariants: Zero managed memory leakage of cryptographic keys

NetworkGateway.description: Chromium 108 wire fingerprint HTTP handler, Google DoH fallback DNS resolver, 4-byte binary framing engine with zero-allocation ReadOnlySpan slicing, and ClientWebSocket duplex actor.
invariants: Zero heap allocation for 4-byte header decoding

BusinessDomain.description: Multi-step QR authentication state machine, 5-stage message transmission lifecycle (10 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4), mention offset re-basing, recall, soft-delete undo timers, reaction aggregation, chunked media uploads, ISO-BMFF thumbnail extraction, diacritic-insensitive search, and master ZaloClient coordinator.

PresentationViewModels.description: Pure Clean MVVM ViewModels using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm source generators ([ObservableProperty], [RelayCommand]). 100% UI-agnostic with zero references to Microsoft.UI.Xaml.*. UI thread marshalling strictly via DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue.
invariants: Property change notification on all bindable fields

PresentationViewsControls.description: WinUI 3 native Fluent UI pages, virtualized ListViews, compiled {x:Bind} bindings, 14-subtype message bubble DataTemplates, and dynamic localization binding via {Binding [Key], Source={StaticResource Localization}}. Zero code-behind business logic or visual tree manipulation.
invariants: Zero code-behind DOM manipulation (Children.Add/Remove, container swapping)

TestingHarness.description: Comprehensive automated test suite covering unit tests, integration tests, contract compliance tests, Roslyn architectural scanners, localization verification, and non-intrusive agent-desktop live UI automation.
invariants: Real state verification with zero dummy implementations

layer_boundary_verification.acyclic_dependency_flow: PresentationViewsControls -> PresentationViewModels -> BusinessDomain -> [StorageServices, CryptoServices, NetworkGateway] -> CoreContracts -> CoreModels
layer_isolation_rules: CoreModels has 0 outgoing dependencies to any other project layers.
CoreContracts depends strictly on CoreModels and BCL primitives.
StorageServices, CryptoServices, and NetworkGateway depend only on CoreModels, CoreContracts, and external BCL/NuGet libraries.
BusinessDomain coordinates Storage, Crypto, and Network through their respective interface contracts.
PresentationViewModels depends solely on BusinessDomain and CoreContracts interfaces; strictly isolated from PresentationViewsControls.
PresentationViewsControls consumes PresentationViewModels via compiled data binding and never mutates lower infrastructure directly.
TestingHarness observes all layers via explicit test fixtures without circular feedback into product assemblies.

red_phase.rule: Every subagent MUST write a failing test first before modifying production source code.
red_phase.verification: Execute the targeted test command and assert that it fails with the expected exception/failure. Record failing evidence in progress log.

green_phase.rule: Write only the minimal genuine implementation code required to satisfy the failing test. No dummy or hardcoded facades.
green_phase.verification: Re-run the targeted test command and confirm green status.

refactor_phase.rule: Refactor and harden: enforce Roslyn IDE0065 using directives outside namespace, 100% XML doc comments in technical American English, UTF-8 without BOM, and Windows CRLF line endings.
refactor_phase.verification: Re-run all module tests and graphify update . to ensure no regressions or circular dependencies.

governing_principles: Principle III: Secure Database & Credential Protection
Principle IV: High Performance & Thread Stewardship

governing_principles: Principle IV: High Performance & Async Stewardship
GATE_03.exit_criteria: Zero heap allocations during 4-byte WebSocket header slicing. Outbound HTTP requests carry exact Chromium 108 wire fingerprints with Origin/Referer stripped. QR state machine transitions properly, and error -20 triggers QR2 seamlessly.

GATE_04.exit_criteria: Message delivery pipeline progresses reliably through all delivery stages. Mention offsets strictly align. Recall mutates kind to .recalled. Soft-delete undo timer cancels deletion correctly. Media downloads throttle to max 3 concurrent requests. Master ZaloClient coordinates clean lifecycle.

governing_principles: Principle I: Clean MVVM & Type Safety

Principle VII: Zero Hardcoded Strings & Dynamic i18n
GATE_06.exit_criteria: 100% {x:Bind} compiled data binding verified. Code-behind files contain only InitializeComponent(). Zero raw string literals in XAML headers/content/placeholders. All 14 message payload DataTemplates compile and resolve cleanly via MessageBubbleTemplateSelector.
